title: Connections Rate (CPS) Anomaly
summary: AgenticOps has detected anomalous patterns in firewall connections <random_number>

analysis.detail: Cisco AgenticOps has identified an anomalous pattern in firewall connections, deviating significantly from established usage trends. This unexpected behavior warrants immediate investigation to determine the root cause. Persistent occurrences may necessitate precautionary measures. If this alert is a false positive, consider reducing the anomaly detection sensitivity threshold.

probableCauses.title: TCP Connections Rate
probableCauses.detail: AgenticOps observed a decrease in tcp connections rate, which may have impacted connections

remediation.markdownText:
### To troubleshoot or remediate the issue, you should:
- Check firewall logs for errors and unusual activity.
- Monitor network traffic for anomalies.
- Review firewall configuration for errors.
- Check firewall hardware and software for issues.
- Analyze network connectivity for problems.
- Review security policies to ensure they are not too permissive or restrictive.
